findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_price" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "shopping" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_price, find_products, lookup_gtin · Public sink: cheapest_path · Destructive: find_products, product_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_price, find_products, lookup_gtin · Public sink: cheapest_path · Destructive: find_products, product_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
